provenance.raw_volume_flag: derived finite/nonnegative/zero-consistent observed fields; never future forecast flags

analysis_3_graph_delay.delay_definition: target retained trigger index minus source episode t0; all sources are co-origins at t0
analysis_3_graph_delay.dependence: Co-origins and overlapping event windows can repeat the same target trigger; observations are not independent.
analysis_3_graph_delay.availability_reason: Only the frozen January graph is authorized as the graph source; no February graph is constructed.
analysis_3_graph_delay.lead_time_conclusion: 图谱仅描述，不承诺提前量
analysis_3_graph_delay.tail_limit: No inference outside 30 minutes; 30 minus delay is not operational warning lead time.

analysis_5_decay.event_tier_aggregation: median of all required tier asset ratios; any zero baseline excludes that event-tier
analysis_5_decay.bands: 95% pointwise day-block intervals, not simultaneous confidence bands
analysis_5_decay.right_censoring: Unconfirmed recovery remains >120; never replaced by 120 or silently discarded.

recovery.median_definition: Earliest h with cumulative confirmed recovery >=50% of all valid event-tier curves; no averaging of censored times.

analysis_7_observed_volume.window: 30 minute volumes ending at t0, including the triggering window
analysis_7_observed_volume.control_rule: Previous 28 calendar days, same UTC minute and weekday/weekend class; no retained trigger of any asset within control +/-120 minutes
analysis_7_observed_volume.baseline: median of control 30-minute base-asset volume sums, within the same asset
analysis_7_observed_volume.observed_validity: Historical raw volume and quote amount finite/nonnegative/zero-consistent; no future forecast validity filter
implementation_notes: Control exclusion is exactly c-120 through c+120, not the expanded 30-minute volume window.
The full control context must have detector_known=True; each month's first 65 indices are unknown.
Raw 12-column CSV has no explicit validity flag; explicit-invalid counts are zero, derived invalidity is separate.
Numeric catalog direction +1/-1/0 maps explicitly to up/down/mixed.
Only the four combined up/down by tier contrasts receive the shared family-of-26 adjustment; individual months show ordinary intervals and must have positive estimates and sufficient support.
analysis_7_observed_volume.aggregation: mean log ratio across all required tier assets, then equal-weight event mean; geometric multiple is exp(mean log ratio)
analysis_7_observed_volume.missing_policy: No epsilon, no imputation, no bridging missing data, no model future-volume filter
